name: Satyapala
notes: Strong mutual trust. Complementary roles: he protects people from the forest, she extracts value from it.

name: Nagadatta
notes: Sees strong potential, but worries he is becoming too independent too early.

name: Gopala
notes: Cooperative relationship based on shared terrain knowledge.

name: Revati

name: Bhumaka
notes: Respects his need for resources; occasional disputes over over-harvesting.
